program.section_heading: Office Skills: Word and Excel Certificate of Completion
outcomes: Apply basic word processing features to create, edit, merge, and print documents.
Apply basic features of working with images, graphics, Smart Art, and Word Art in documents including inserting, cropping, drawings, and resizing.
Manage files and folders for efficient saving and retrieval of word-processing and spreadsheet documents
Plan, create, edit, and print Excel spreadsheet files using basic spreadsheet features for cells, worksheets, and workbooks
Apply formulas and functions in an Excel spreadsheet
Create a variety of charts and graphs to represent data in an Excel spreadsheet

Determine and apply appropriate problem-solving techniques using Help and reference material off and online (i.e., LinkedIn Learning) for the successful creation of basic documents using Microsoft Word and Microsoft Excel.
